messages:
nora: Noticing a surge of mTLS handshake failures from proxies in ap-south-1 over the last 8m. 1.2k connection drops. Root errors show keystore unwrap AccessDenied to KMS.

ops-bot: ALERT: mTLS handshake spike (proxy-ap-south-*)  cert-rotator reporting KMS Decrypt denies. See incident link: https://alerts.internal/INC-4712 :rotating_light:

luca: Can someone paste the rotator/proxy logs?

nora: Logs: 
```
2026-03-21T14:04:02Z proxy[proxy-ap-2]: tls_handshake_error: keystore unwrap failed: kms:DecryptAccessDenied Caller=svc:rotator@ap-south-1
2026-03-21T14:04:03Z rotator[rotator-1]: unwrap failed for wrapped_key id=wrp-789: AccessDenied
```

tess: We pushed an RBAC tighten at 14:00 to the rotator-eu/ap role - removed kms:Decrypt from rotator SA in ap-south to limit cross-region decrypt. That probably broke unwraps.

auditor-bot: AUDIT CHECK: KMS CloudTrail shows Encrypt/CreateKey events but no Decrypt events for svc/rotator in ap-south during window. Possible audit forwarder drop - creating ticket SEC-1199.

luca: If rotator can't unwrap, proxies can't present cert chains for mTLS and will abort. We also see an uptick in 502s from edge.

nora: Quick mitigations: 1) revert the RBAC change (fast), 2) switch proxies to a pre-warmed cert bundle stored in GCS, 3) perform a controlled rotator restart after RBAC patch. Thoughts?

infra-bot: Pre-warmed bundle available: gs://redwood-prewarm/ap/proxy-bundle-v3.tar.gz

tess: Revert RBAC now and roll a canary test. I'll run iamctl.

luca: Also we need an alert rule for KMS Decrypt Deny events and a CI unwrap smoke test when RBAC changes are merged.

nora: Running a quick TLS client check:
`openssl s_client -connect proxy.ap-south.redwood.ai:443 -servername proxy.ap-south.redwood.ai -tls1_3`
Result: no certificate presented, TLS alert handshake_failure.

infra-bot: Suggested rollback command:
```
iamctl patch role rotator-ap-south --add-perm "kms:Decrypt" --resource arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:123456789012:key/keystore-main
```

tess: Executed rollback. iamctl: role patched successfully. Monitoring metrics and logs.

ops-bot: RESOLVE: handshake failures subsided within 6m after role rollback. Dashboard: https://metrics.internal/d/handshakes/ap-south :white_check_mark:

nora: Post-incident actions: - Add RBAC canary job that runs a KMS unwrap in staging when role changes are proposed. - Add alert for KMS Decrypt denies with rate threshold. - Fix audit-forwarder to ensure Decrypt events are forwarded. - Add proxy readiness probe to use cached bundle if unwrap fails for 30s to avoid mass disconnects during short JP/rotation windows.

luca: I'll open SEC-1200 for the canary + CI test. tess, please add the audit-forwarder work to your queue.

auditor-bot: Tickets created: SEC-1199 (missing decrypt audit events) and SEC-1200 (RBAC unwrap canary).

nora: One more follow-up: consider adding a small ktl (keystore test lib) that runs an unwrap/verify as part of RBAC PRs to catch permission regressions early.

infra-bot: Also recommended: increase session-ticket grace and extend stapling cache TTL for 5m during cert rotations to reduce user impact.

tess: Adding all follow-ups to the sprint board. Assigning owners: tess (RBAC canary + rollback runbook), luca (CI unwrap test + ktl), nora (readiness probe + proxy TD). Closing this thread, writing incident summary now. :memo:
